Oil prices react to rise in U.S. inventories
![The increase in U.S. oil inventories affected global prices (Photo: Reuters)](https://static.nv.ua/shared/system/Article/posters/003/404/246/original/6112915c82c66148c2cca383939fec7e.png?q=85&stamp=20261118122950&w=900&f=webp) 
The increase in U.S. oil inventories affected global prices (Photo: Reuters)
Oil prices fell on Nov. 18 on data showing a rise in U.S. oil and fuel stocks last week, although the conflict between the U.S. and Iran and shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz limited the decline, according to Reuters.
Brent crude futures fell $1.15 cents, or 1.2%, to $91.
